notes.title: Cosmo Clash v1.0 has launched!
notes.content:
Cosmo Clash is now out of Early Access, and is packed with new features! Here are all the changes:

[i][h2]New Features[/h2][/i]
+ Shots can now be charged. Hold the shoot button to charge, and release for a powerful shot!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593656/4705cf5e242ccb7ecae83f18206b8784d96dbd8b.gif[/img]

+ Dashes can now be charged. Hold the dash button, release for a longer dash!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593656/a28a554deb9ad866421a6b40426a9033ce3a52ff.gif[/img]

+ Automatic reload has been removed. Out of ammo? Pick up ammo on the stage!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593656/b80b15d71d5b086c7be33dfd8e81843c61fa3de6.gif[/img]

+ Special weapons are now one-use only. Make those rocket launchers count!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593656/e5b3bc550e26a36f414103a81552572b00d15b7e.gif[/img]

+ CHARACTER SELECTION! Finally!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593656/e8bbe9b1ac3c35b631afbc82c8dd4066d1004079.gif[/img]

Characters have improved animations, and will react whenever you pick up powerups or sustain damage! Emote galore! ːsteamhappyː

+ Added credits screen.

[i][h3]- Balancing/Tweaks -[/h3][/i]
+ Bees now continue off screen when fired.
+ Bounce blades now bounce 5 times down from 3. Beware, they can backfire now!
+ Removed melee weapons (for now). They are very imbalanced in their current state.
+ Royale circle shrink less.
+ Smaller saw blades on certain stages.
+ Reduced margin of move spotting on 'Red Light' stage.
+ Slowed down moving saws.

[i][h3]- Stage Changes -[/h3][/i]
+ Laser stages now uses short-range lasers. They can also destroy items!
+ Asteroid stage has reduced number of asteroids.
+ Saws on saw stages now destroys items on impact.

[i][h3]- BUG fixes -[/h3][/i]
+ Wrecking Ball Special now gets turned off when player is defeated.
+ Bomb arrows now explode on player impact as intented.

notes.title: Update v.007c launched - Bow & Arrows!
notes.content:
In this update, it's time for some medieval weapons - The Bow! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593656/65888f1b423bc331b15c60fc02bbcfb6a5d58cbe.gif[/img]

The new weapons include:

[list]
[*]Crossbow - Can be shot 3 times, shoots regular arrows that curve downwards (space works funny in this game). Regular arrows bursts bubbleshields in one hit!
[*]Tripple Bow - Shoots once, but fires 3 arrows simultaniously in an arc.
[*]Bomb Arrows - Same as Tripple Bow, but explodes after 0.5sec & on impact.
[*]Ice Arrows - Same as Tripple Bow, but freezes players on impact. Frozen players cannot move, and must tap their buttons fast to unfreeze!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593656/9b1fd4817dfe40d0f9448dde0cce58bd4b6822af.gif[/img]

That's it for this weeks update! Enjoy the new weapons space archers!

notes.title: v0.007 now in Beta - New Game Mode!
notes.content:
We're slooowly getting back from vacation here, with a bunch of new ideas! First off, we've added a new game mode called 'King Of The Ring'!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593656/41ceab57c6a0f4064e0c14bda135d661ad14b199.gif[/img]

[i]The rules are simple:[/i]
Stay inside the ring to gain points! Whoever scores enough points, wins the match.

With the new weapons and mines added in the previous update, you can set up traps or protective barriers around the ring as you try and scramble for more points. Each player has an infinite amount of lives, and will respawn back into the game after 5 sec if they are defeated.

Expect plenty of bugs until we move this one out of beta! 

Other minor adjustments are:
+ Melee weapons can now only be swung once (down from 3 swings), until they are thrown. This is because they are waaaay to powerful for their own good.

notes.title: Update v0.005 + Summer Vacation
notes.content:
This update brings weapon crates! We've added 4 new weapons that spawn randomly on each stage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593656/87ccc099d2fd579046343314d82d3f4b5b3cd366.png[/img]

+ Rocket Launcher - On pickup, gain 3x rockets that explode in a radius on impact. They can destroy most traps, and opponents caught in the explosion is instantly vapourised!
+ Sniper - On pickup, gain 3x sniper bullets. They are the fastest bullet available, and will instantly defeat opponents on impact. A handy scope will activate with this weapon, to show you the path of the projectile.
+ Chainsaw - A melee weapon that can wreck havok on your foes! Press the shoot button to perform a swiping attack, that'll wipe out any opponents in it's wake. On the third swipe, all melee weapons will be thrown in the direction you're facing.
+ Nun-chucks - A non-lethal melee weapon. Use it to stun your foes, or knock them into traps! As with chainsaw, on the third swipe, it will automaticly be thrown in the direction you are facing.

For the next update we will add a Nun-chucks ONLY mode, where nun-chucks will spawn regularly, and the goal is to push opponents into traps! 

With that, we're off on summer vacation! We'll be updating the game every Friday again once we're back!  

Meanwhile, feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/dJGUU8HUjn]Discord[/url]! Have a nice summer everyone!

notes.title: V.004 - Now in Beta - Extra Lives
notes.content:
It's a tiny additon, making a huge difference in how the game plays out. We've experimented with giving each player 'Extra Lives'. Each time an opponent is defeated, they will lose a life and respawn in 3 sec. Opponents are permanently defeated once their lives are spent.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593656/d6f64cf17cf167100ea01cde18f2516c3983e6f4.gif[/img]

Each player start off with 3 Extra Lives by default. You can turn off Extra Lives by setting them to 0 in the menu.

We'll be testing this in beta until Friday - feel free to check out the beta branch on Steam before Friday to check out this new feature!

notes.title: Update v0.002 - Now in beta
notes.content:
We took some notes from the launch party at Soria Moria, and made a couple of improvements to several key aspects.

+ Players can now move freely within their "READY BOX" - making it easier to learn the controls pre-match.
+ Reduced 'Special Crate' hp. They can now be destroyed with only 1 shot.
+ Bullets are now 75% slower inside SLUDGE (up from 90%).
+ HUD elements now react to HUD being pushed by player.
+ Ready Countdown now starts from 5 sec.
+ Ammo/Shield Prompts now blink to make them more visible.

To enter the beta-build, right click Cosmo Clash in your library and click 'properties'. From here, select Betas and select 'beta' from the dropdown menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593656/45ca85b6ace27a69a917ed71eb31501c641cf1f2.png[/img]
